title: Coated
doc: The lacquer and car-paint family until the standard has a coat layer: a smooth dielectric with a white, full specular written out.

provenance.note: specular_ior 1.5, a clear coat being a glass-like polymer

base_metalness 0 by definition; specular_weight 1 and specular_color white are the physical values, written so the family reads as coated; specular_roughness 0.1 for a lacquer; base_color 0.5 a mid value
